findings.proposed: Choisir « Uniquement les agents de mon choix » fait basculer les nouvelles conversations dans ce sens vers cette liste.

findings.current: Ajoutez au moins un agent ou une personne, ou choisissez « Toute mon organisation ».
findings.proposed: Ajoutez au moins un agent ou une personne, ou choisissez « Toute mon organisation ».
findings.reason: Same guillemet spacing drift as allowlist.cue_listed_only; the string must also quote the same option label, which it does.

{at} is an age fragment, not a date: library-page.tsx:267 `relative()` returns "5h ago"/"2d ago", so the string renders "Dernier classement le 5h ago" — « le » is only valid before a date, and English carries no preposition.

{at} comes from library-model.ts:347 `relativeTime()` ("2h ago"/"3d ago") via library-preview.tsx:355, so the rendered line reads "Classé par librarian le 2h ago"; the inserted « le » makes it ungrammatical.

{title} is a conversation title used as a provenance link (library-preview.tsx:401-411); « depuis » is read temporally ("since") when it stands alone, while the control navigates back to that conversation.

21 characters against 14 in English, in a filter rail that renders a count beside the label; the context defines the option as the whole catalog, so « Tout le catalogue » is both shorter and closer to the intent.

findings.proposed: Sélectionnez un élément pour en voir l’aperçu
findings.reason: « afficher en aperçu » is not idiomatic; French expresses this with « voir l'aperçu de ».

findings.proposed: il y a {count, number} min — keep; run the rendered check at sidebar width, fall back to {count, number} min if it truncates
findings.reason: 12 characters against 6 in English ("4m ago") for a fragment whose context says "Keep the unit compact for narrow sidebar rows"; hours_ago, days_ago and the composed link_down_compact ("Lien coupé · il y a 4 min", 25 chars vs 17) carry the same +100% growth.
« écrire à » takes a person as recipient; a conversation is written in, not to, so the current wording reads translated.

findings.current: {count, plural, one {{count} non lu} many {{count} de non lus} other {{count} non lus}}
findings.proposed: {count, plural, one {{count} non lu} many {{count} de non-lus} other {{count} non lus}}
findings.reason: The many branch renders at 1,000,000 as "1000000 de non lus": « de » needs a noun head, and the substantivized adjective takes a hyphen (« de non-lus »).
